lines.zh: 地球用了数十亿年，才迎来复杂生命的繁盛。
lines.en: It took the Earth billions of years to bring forth the flourishing of complex life.

lines.zh: 从埃迪卡拉纪幽暗的浅海，
lines.en: From the dim, shallow seas of the Ediacaran,
and great beasts striding across the wilds,

lines.zh: 再到有人仰望星空，计算群星的年龄。
lines.en: and then to someone gazing up at the night sky, reckoning the ages of the stars.

lines.zh: 一颗行星上的物质，终于开始追问自己的来历。
lines.en: The matter of one planet has begun, at last, to ask where it came from.
